title: AVARI Tennis Studio: Where to play indoor tennis in Manila
summary: Founded by tennis enthusiasts and cousins Abby Frias Teotico and Anton Bernal, AVARI, the country's first tennis simulation studio, offers a place to practice in Mandaluyong, rain or shine.
